## Description {#details}

The <code>reflection</code> namespace provides facilities for obtaining source location information and type names at compile time, supporting enhanced reporting and diagnostics within the µTest++ framework.

It includes a local implementation of <code><Link to="/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/reflection/source-location">source&#95;location</Link></code> for environments lacking C++20 standard support, as well as utilities for extracting concise type names from compiler-specific macros such as <code>&#95;&#95;PRETTY&#95;FUNCTION&#95;&#95;</code>.

All definitions within this namespace are intended to facilitate advanced reflection and reporting features, and are implemented in the <code>include/micro-os-plus</code> folder to maintain a structured and modular codebase.
